shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la; cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css; find .. -name AGENTS.md -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat index.html; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | head -30; git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -35; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; rg "export.*(Provider|configure)" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts; cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | rg '(PasswordInput|TextInput|Provider).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/PasswordInput.md | head -65; rg -n 'Provider|TextInput' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; ls node_modules/@playwright 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e 'const fs = require(\"fs\"); const p = \"index.html\"; fs.writeFileSync(p, fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\").replace(\"lang=\\\"en\\\"\", \"lang=\\\"ru\\\"\").replace(\"<title>Gravity UI eval</title>\", \"<meta name=\\\"theme-color\\\" content=\\\"#fafbf8\\\" />\\n    <meta name=\\\"description\\\" content=\\\"Войдите в своё пространство для работы, проектов и больших идей.\\\" />\\n    <title>Вход в аккаунт — Gravity UI</title>\"));'; npm ls --depth=0; rg --files /tmp /usr/local/lib/node_modules /opt 2>/dev/null | rg '(playwright|puppeteer)' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e 'const {chromium}=require(\"/tmp/gravity-ui-check/node_modules/playwright\"); (async()=>{ const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true}); const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:1000}}); await page.goto(\"http://localhost:5174\"); await page.screenshot({path:\"/tmp/gravity-desktop.png\",fullPage:true}); console.log(await page.locator(\"button\").evaluateAll(bs=>bs.map(b=>({text:b.textContent,label:b.getAttribute(\"aria-label\")})))); await browser.close(); })().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})'"
